title: Set 59

sentences.ko: 벤이 포틀랜드 쪽 자리를 제안받았는데 돈이 진짜 세. 그래서 이번 주 내내 밤마다 그 얘기로 왔다 갔다 하고 있어. 나는 어디서든 일할 수 있으니까 그게 문제는 아니고. 문제는 밤 열 시에 진짜로 전화할 수 있는 친구가 여기 생기기까지 6년이 걸렸다는 거야. 그런 친구를 또 만들 수 있을지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: Ben got offered something out in Portland, and it's real money, so we've been going back and forth about it every night this week. And I could do my job from anywhere, so that's not even the issue. The problem is it took me like six years to have friends here I'd actually call at ten at night, and I don't know if I get that twice.

alts.text: So Ben's got an offer out in Portland, and the money's real, so we've been hashing it out every night this week. I can work from anywhere, so that's not even the issue. The thing is it took me like six years to have friends here I'd actually call at ten at night, and I don't know if I get that twice.

Ben has been offered a position in Portland, and the money is substantial, so we have been going back and forth about it every evening this week. I am able to do my job from anywhere, so that is not the issue at all. The difficulty is that it took me roughly six years to have friends here I would genuinely call at ten at night, and I do not know whether I get that twice.

sentences.note: **going back and forth**는 결정을 못 내리고 의견이 이쪽저쪽으로 왔다 갔다 하는 것입니다. 캐주얼의 **hashing it out**은 결론을 내려고 따져 가며 의논하는 쪽이라 조금 더 적극적입니다.

sentences.ko: 샤워한 지 5분쯤 되면 온수가 끊기고 그다음엔 찬물이 나와요. 지난주 언젠가부터 계속 그래요. 봄에 사람 불러서 손본 건 아는데 그때 고친 게 오래 못 갔어요. 그분 다시 불러 주실 수 있을까요? 지금은 순서를 정해서 씻는데, 두 번째로 들어가는 사람이 그걸 그대로 당하거든요.
sentences.text: The hot water quits about five minutes into a shower and then it comes back cold, and it's been doing that since last week sometime. I know you had somebody out for it in the spring, but whatever he did didn't hold. Can you get him back out here? Because right now we're taking turns and whoever goes second is the one who finds out.

alts.text: About five minutes into a shower the hot water just quits, and then it comes back cold, and it's been doing that since sometime last week. I know you had a guy out for it in the spring, but whatever he did didn't stick. Any chance you can get him back out here? Right now we're taking turns and whoever goes second is the one who finds out.

The hot water stops approximately five minutes into a shower and then returns cold, and it has been doing so since sometime last week. I understand you had someone come out for it in the spring, but whatever he did has not held. Could you please have him come back out here? At present we are taking turns, and whoever goes second is the one who finds out.

sentences.note: **had somebody out for it**은 집으로 기사를 불러 봐 달라고 한 것입니다. **didn't hold**는 고친 게 얼마 못 가 도로 고장 났다는 뜻이고, 캐주얼에서는 같은 뜻으로 **didn't stick**을 씁니다.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 보러 오시기 전에 미리 말씀드릴게요. 왼쪽 쿠션에 얼룩이 있어서 안 보이게 뒤집어 놨어요. 그리고 다리 하나가 자꾸 헐거워져서 1년에 두어 번은 조여 줘야 해요. 그것만 빼면 괜찮은 소파예요. 그래서 산 값 안 받고 100달러에 내놓은 거고요. 집에 가져가서 저한테 문자 주시는 것보다 지금 말씀드리는 게 나을 것 같아서요.
sentences.text: Before you come look at it, there's a stain on the left cushion, I've got it flipped over so you won't see it, and one of the legs works itself loose, so I tighten it a couple times a year. It's a good couch otherwise. That's why I've got it at a hundred instead of what I paid, and I'd rather tell you now than have you get it home and text me about it.

alts.text: Just so you know before you swing by, there's a stain on the left cushion, I've got it flipped so you won't see it, and one of the legs works itself loose, so I tighten it a couple times a year. Good couch otherwise. That's why it's a hundred and not what I paid. I'd rather tell you now than have you get it home and text me about it.

Before you come to look at it, I should mention that there is a stain on the left cushion, which I have turned over so that you will not see it, and one of the legs works itself loose, so I tighten it a couple of times a year. It is a good couch otherwise. That is why I have it at a hundred rather than what I paid, and I would rather tell you now than have you take it home and text me about it.

sentences.note: **works itself loose**는 쓰다 보면 저절로 헐거워진다는 뜻으로, 사람이 푼 게 아니라는 어감입니다. **otherwise**는 앞에 말한 흠만 빼면 나머지는 괜찮다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 한 시간쯤은 괜찮았어. 그러다 삼촌이 식탁에서 다 듣게 나한테 얼마 버냐고 물었어. 그러고 나니까 다들 하나씩 더 묻더라. 월세는 얼마냐, 왜 아직 월세 사냐, 모아 둔 돈은 있냐. 나 서른네 살인데 저녁 식사 내내 면접이 됐어. 엄마는 그냥 앉아서 그러게 놔두더라.
sentences.text: It was fine for about an hour, and then my uncle asked what I make, out loud, at the table, and after that everybody had a follow up. How much is your rent, why are you still renting, do you have anything saved. I'm thirty four and the whole dinner turned into an interview, and my mom just sat there and let it happen.

alts.text: Things were fine for maybe an hour, and then my uncle asks what I make, out loud, at the table, and after that everybody had a follow up. What's your rent, why are you still renting, you got anything saved. I'm thirty four and the whole dinner turned into an interview, and my mom just sat there and let it happen.

It went well for about an hour, and then my uncle asked what I earn, out loud, at the table, and after that everyone had a follow up question. How much is your rent, why are you still renting, do you have anything saved. I am thirty four, and the entire dinner turned into an interview, and my mother simply sat there and allowed it to happen.

sentences.note: **out loud**는 조용히 따로 묻는 게 아니라 다 들리게 소리 내어 물었다는 뜻입니다. **a follow up**은 앞 질문에 이어서 던지는 추가 질문입니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 혹시 물어보면 나 오늘 아침에 치과 예약 있었던 거야. 그렇게 말해 놨거든. 이번 달에 벌써 두 번 지각해서, 그 앞에서 알람을 두 개나 못 듣고 잤다고 말할 수는 없잖아. 그러니까 자세한 건 너무 친절하게 대답하지 마.
sentences.text: Okay, if she asks, I had a dentist appointment this morning, that's what I told her. Because I've already been late twice this month, and I'm not going to stand there and tell her I slept through two alarms. So just don't be too helpful with the details.

alts.text: Hey, so I told her I had a dentist thing this morning, that's the story if she asks. I've already been late twice this month, and I'm not gonna stand there and tell her I slept through two alarms. So just don't get too helpful with the details.

If she asks, I had a dentist appointment this morning, that is what I told her. I have already been late twice this month, and I am not going to stand there and tell her that I slept through two alarms. So please do not be too helpful with the details.

sentences.note: **slept through two alarms**는 알람이 두 번이나 울렸는데도 못 듣고 계속 잤다는 말입니다. **don't be too helpful with the details**는 도와준답시고 세세하게 말해서 들통나게 하지 말라는 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 3번 캐주얼이 첫 마디만 다르고 나머지는 text 와 글자까지 똑같아서, 더 짧고 축약된 구어로 다시 썼습니다 (Good couch otherwise / That's why it's a hundred and not what I paid 로 끊었습니다).
2번 한국어가 집주인에게 하는 말인데 반말이어서 해요체로 바꿨습니다. 영어는 그대로 편한 말투라 뜻은 달라지지 않습니다.
3번 한국어도 처음 보는 구매자에게 하는 말이라 해요체로 바꿨습니다.
4번 캐주얼의 have you got anything saved 는 영국식 어감이라 미국 구어인 you got anything saved 로 바꿨습니다.
5번 한국어의 '그 사람이' 는 번역투라 뺐고(한국어는 주어를 잘 안 붙입니다), '앞에 서서 말할' 은 '그 앞에서 말할' 로 다듬었습니다.
